controls: Replaying the already committed identical chunk returns the same received offset without duplication.
A conflicting replay and an offset gap are rejected; a tail written without a committed offset is truncated before retry.
The resumed asset byte-for-byte matches the original and its SHA-256 matches the original upload digest.
The uploaded state reports every expected byte committed; repeated finalization remains idempotent.
Live-stream sealing verifies caller-provided exact byte count and digest before ingest.
